resources.string: The host Xlorie renderer is configured separately. XFCE uses its default container environment; independent container GPU acceleration is not configured.

KWin runs on the host; Plasma Shell runs inside Ubuntu. Container Zink / Turnip requires host Zink for GPU buffer sharing. Container LLVMpipe works with System EGL, Zink or LLVMpipe on the host. Software Vulkan uses the CPU.
This host and container renderer pair is unsupported. Check the supported pairs shown above; both selections must be set explicitly.

GNOME 50 uses Android System EGL for the compositor. Applications inside Ubuntu 26.04 LTS use LLVMpipe software rendering. Container GPU acceleration is not supported. Stop the desktop to export a complete container backup.
Ubuntu style · Native GNOME. Yaru theme, left Dock, system tray and desktop icons. Uses Android System EGL; runs native Termux applications.
